name: Push Notifications
description: Web Push notifications for alerts — delivered to the Android/desktop notification tray via the PWA service worker, even when the app is closed
author: Wolffie

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Initial release — Web Push notifications triggered by alertService 'alert' events
VAPID keypair auto-generated on first run and persisted in settings
Severity threshold configurable; subscriptions stored per-device
